fixes.en: Selecting text in the PDF works again: the highlight shows on live-preview pages and in the dark theme.
fixes.zh: PDF 中的文字选择恢复正常：实时预览页面和深色主题下都会显示选区高亮。
输入 \includegraphics 时不再被变成 \include{graphics}。

fixes.en: Renaming a .tex file no longer deletes PDFs with the same name.
fixes.zh: 重命名 .tex 文件时不再删除同名的 PDF。

fixes.en: Compile errors are no longer lost or pointed at the wrong file.
fixes.zh: 编译错误不再丢失，也不再指向错误的文件。

fixes.en: Overleaf track changes are respected when you edit, and tracked deletions are shown in the right place.
fixes.zh: 编辑时会遵循 Overleaf 的修订跟踪，被跟踪的删除内容也会显示在正确的位置。

fixes.en: Folder rows that stick to the top of the file tree no longer overlap the rows scrolling under them.
fixes.zh: 文件树中吸顶的文件夹行不再与下方滚动的行重叠。

fixes.en: Resolving or deleting a comment now confirms what happened and offers Undo.
fixes.zh: 解决或删除评论后会提示操作结果，并提供撤销。

fixes.en: Comment details: a delete button, a centred reply field, a seamless popover arrow and a better-sized gutter pin.
fixes.zh: 评论细节改进：新增删除按钮，回复框居中，弹出框箭头无缝衔接，侧边栏标记尺寸更合适。

fixes.en: The caret in the agent panel is drawn at text height.
fixes.zh: 智能体面板中的光标高度与文字一致。
